theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → Measurable θ → StronglyMeasurable ζ → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μ < ∞ → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → StronglyMeasurable (fun x => θ x • ζ x) ∧ ∫⁻ x in M, ‖θ x • ζ x‖ₑ ∂μ < ∞
